|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current full-face version; the current full-face version is [[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V7-L-diceibegon-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates identify repository uploads for full faces and the printed edition for the partial slip; neither proves the first publication day. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-diceibegon022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/diceibegon.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/diceibegon.gif (today's copy is the latest full-face image only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Dice Ibegon”. Text: “Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace or Endor site. If just lost, place Dice in Used Pile. If opponent is about to draw destiny for an Interrupt targeting your character here, opponent must first lose 1 Force, then shuffle their Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 4 November 2022<ref name="img-diceibegona57375e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/diceibegon.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5 commit a57375e] (4 November 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual7-Light/large/diceibegon.gif (today's copy is the latest full-face image only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Dice Ibegon” → “Dice Ibegon” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Dice Ibegon”. It is the current full-face image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace or Endor site. If just lost, place Dice in Used Pile. If opponent is about to draw destiny for an Interrupt targeting your character here, opponent must first lose 1 Force, then shuffle their Reserve Deck.”

* '''Partial slip''' ([[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata 2)]]): This is the third documented image, titled Errata 2; the partial prints no errata mark. The printed mark differs from the image-version count; see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Official Set 7 sheet, September 2023 edition]], page 2.</ref>  the September 2023 edition of [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Virtual Set 7]] publishes the bottom-only layout with the same current game wording.
